description: The file is a comprehensive documentation markdown file describing the Mesh Agent component within an RDK-B ecosystem. It includes system architecture diagrams, detailed features, design principles, internal modules, inter-component interactions, communication flows, and configuration parameters. The content is a mixture of descriptive text, architecture diagrams in Mermaid syntax, and detailed technical specifications for the Mesh Agent's responsibilities, design, and integrations.
